connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

text.description: Text of the post. Required unless media is supplied; leave empty for a media-only post.

media.mediaIds[].description: Uploaded media IDs. Required when Media is provided. Up to four images, one GIF, or one video.

media.taggedUserIds[].description: Up to ten user IDs to tag.

media.previewMediaId.description: Uploaded media used as the preview image.

media.callToActions.visitSite.url.description: HTTPS destination URL. Required when Visit Site is supplied.

media.callToActions.watchNow.url.description: HTTPS destination URL. Required when Watch Now is supplied.

media.callToActions.appInstall.description: Provide at least one store ID.

media.callToActions.appInstall.appStoreI.description: Apple App Store iPhone app ID.

media.callToActions.appInstall.ipadAppSt.description: Apple App Store iPad app ID.

reply.inReplyToTweetId.description: Post to reply to. Required when Reply is supplied.

reply.excludeReplyUserIds[].description: Users to exclude from the reply thread.

poll.options[].description: Two to four choices, each 1–25 characters. Required when Poll is supplied.

poll.durationMinutes.description: Poll duration, 5–10080 minutes. Required when Poll is supplied.

communityId.description: Community where the post is created.

quoteTweetId.description: Post to quote. Requires X Enterprise API access.

editOptions.description: Edit an existing post instead of creating a new one.

editOptions.previousPostId.description: Post being edited. Required when Edit Options is supplied.

geo.placeId.description: Place for geo tagging; account must permit geolocation.

shareWithFollowers.description: Share an exclusive post with all followers.

nullcast.description: Do not display this post in the public timeline.
